input.query: SELECT signup_month, device, SUM(n_signups) n, SUM(n_activated)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) activation, SUM(n_kyc_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) kyc_approved, SUM(n_first_topup)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) first_topup, SUM(n_activated)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_first_topup) activation_per_topup FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month IN (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01',TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1
